title: Node receive timeout accepts values that defeat timer progress or spin the receive loop
description: Security review of python/src/lichen/node.py found Node.__post_init__ does not validate NodeConfig.receive_timeout_ms, while set_config coerces bool/float/string values with int() and imposes no upper bound. A zero/negative constructor value or a radio rejecting such a timeout makes _receive_loop catch and immediately retry forever, causing CPU/log DoS; an arbitrarily large value delays _send_expired_reassembly_aborts far beyond the 60-second SCHC inactivity transition. Enforce one exact positive bounded-integer contract both at construction and update, choose a maximum consistent with proactive reassembly expiry, reject bool/coercive values, and add receive-loop/expiry regressions.
